messages:
Priya (People Ops): Hey folks — final check for Thursday 3pm PST candidate. Need confirmation on: panel lineup, scribe, ASR transcript capture (retention: 30d), and whether to include a short optional take-home if we finish early. Attached calendar invite. @Samir can you enable ASR for the room? :wave:
Samir (ML Infra): On it. Which room/region? Hosted or docked VPC?
Priya (People Ops): Hosted in us-west-2. Room name: interview-3p-172. Also please apply the quicknotes template to the meeting (debrief form link: https://redwood.app/debriefs).
Maya (Panel Coord): I can be scribe unless Liz wants it. Confirmed panel: Elena, Liz, Arjun + me. Leaving a 10m buffer after the slot.
Liz (Interviewer): I can scribe if needed. Quick q: do we want to weight system-design 40% or 30% this round? Given role I'd lean 40%.
Elena (Hiring Manager): 40% sounds right to me. Also let's add a 15m optional take-home whiteboard (architecture prompt) if the candidate finishes early.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: please complete the debrief form within 24h after the interview. Template: https://redwood.app/debriefs/template (auto-reminder enabled).
Samir (ML Infra): ASR toggled for room `interview-3p-172` in us-west-2. Command run: `infractl asr enable --room interview-3p-172 --retention 30d`. Logs show success. :white_check_mark:
Priya (People Ops): Awesome — scribe + transcript confirmed. @Liz I'll add the 15m take-home as optional on the invite and include the rubric (system-design 40%). Sending final calendar update now. Thanks everyone :pray:
